title: Problems, delays, apologies
lead: Is lesson ke baad tum missed deadline, bug, wrong file ya payment delay par calm English me sorry bol sakte ho, reason bata sakte ho, aur recovery plan de sakte ho.
description: Week 9 English lesson: apologize for a delay, explain the reason, give a fix time, and keep the client calm.

patterns.note: Delay ke liye seedhi, simple apology.
patterns.negative: I'm not happy about the delay either.
patterns.question: Is there a delay?
examples: I'm sorry for the late reply.
Late reply ke liye sorry.
Sorry for the confusion.
Confusion ke liye sorry.
patterns.grammar: sorry for + noun/-ing. sorry to + verb: I'm sorry to say this. Delay ke liye for.
patterns.mistake: “Sorry for delay” → “Sorry for the delay.” Article the chahiye.

patterns.say: There was an issue with the payment gateway.
patterns.positive: There was an issue with the payment gateway.
patterns.negative: There wasn't any issue with the design.
patterns.question: Was there an issue with the server?
examples: There was an issue with the backup.
Backup me problem thi.
There were two issues with the form.
Form me do problems thi.
patterns.grammar: There was + singular; there were + plural. issue with + thing.
patterns.mistake: “There was issue with server” → “There was an issue with the server.” Article a/the.

patterns.say: It's delayed because the content is not ready.
patterns.positive: It's delayed because the content is not ready.
patterns.negative: It's not delayed because of us.
patterns.question: Why is it delayed?
examples: It's delayed because the client changed the design.
Delay hui kyunki client ne design badla.
It's delayed because of the holiday.
Holiday ki wajah se delay hui.
patterns.grammar: because + clause (subject + verb). because of + noun. Difference clear rakho.
patterns.mistake: “because the content not ready” → “because the content is not ready.” Clause me verb chahiye.

patterns.note: Team abhi action me hai — ye confidence deta hai.
patterns.negative: We're not fixing the design today.
patterns.question: When will it be fixed?
examples: We're fixing the login bug now.
Hum login bug abhi theek kar rahe hain.
It will be fixed by evening.
Ye shaam tak theek ho jayega.
patterns.grammar: Present continuous for current action. fix = theek karna. Passive: it will be fixed.
patterns.mistake: “We fixing it” → “We're fixing it.” be verb chahiye.

patterns.note: Client ko next information ka time do.
patterns.say: I'll update you by 4 p.m. today.
patterns.positive: I'll update you by 4 p.m. today.
patterns.negative: I won't have an update before lunch.
patterns.question: When will you update me?
examples: I'll update you by Friday afternoon.
Main Friday dopahar tak update doonga.
I'll update you as soon as I know.
Jaise hi pata chalega, update doonga.
patterns.grammar: update someone by + time. by = deadline. update + person, no to.
patterns.mistake: “I'll update to you” → “I'll update you.” update + person.

patterns.note: Client ke sabr ko recognize karo — call close karne ke liye.
patterns.question: Can you give us a little more time?
examples: Thank you for waiting.
Wait karne ke liye thanks.
Thank you for your understanding.
Samajhne ke liye thanks.
patterns.grammar: Thank you for + noun/-ing. patience = sabr, /ˈpeɪʃns/.
patterns.mistake: “Thank you for your patient” → “Thank you for your patience.” Patient = mareez; patience = sabr.

grammarRules: There was an issue with the server.
It's delayed because the content is late.
Present continuous for a current fix
mistakes: There was an issue with the server.
It's delayed because the content not ready.
It's delayed because the content is not ready.
I'll update to you by Friday.

dialogue.context: Client ka site down hai. Riya = client. Sorry, reason, fix time aur next update — chaar steps.

lines.speaker: Riya
lines.text: The site is still down. What is happening?

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I'm sorry for the delay. There was an issue with the server.

lines.speaker: Riya
lines.text: This is the second time this month.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I understand. We're fixing it right now. It's delayed because the backup took longer than expected.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: It will be fixed in about one hour. I'll update you by 4 p.m.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Thank you for your patience. I'll message you as soon as it is live.

dialogue.closing: Apology ka structure: sorry + reason + fix + next update. Blame mat do, plan do.

speakPrompts.title: 1. Apologize
speakPrompts.starter: I'm sorry for the delay. There was an issue with ___ .

speakPrompts.title: 2. Explain the reason
speakPrompts.prompt: Reason clear bolo, blame ke bina.
speakPrompts.starter: It's delayed because ___ . We're fixing it now.

speakPrompts.title: 3. Give a fix time
speakPrompts.starter: It will be fixed in ___ . I'll update you by ___ .

speakPrompts.title: 4. Calm an angry client
speakPrompts.prompt: Chaar line ka apology record karo.
speakPrompts.starter: I understand. I'm sorry for ___ . We're fixing ___ . I'll update you by ___ . Thank you for your patience.

vocab.example: There was a technical issue with the server.
There is a short delay in testing.
We solved the issue in one hour.
There was a small mistake in the invoice.
I'll send an update by 4 p.m.
The main reason is the late content.

selfCheck: “Sorry for the delay” bina jhijhak boli.
Problem ko “There was an issue with ___” se bataya.
Reason “because ___” se di, blame ke bina.
Next update ka time “by ___” se diya.
“Thank you for your patience” se call close kiya.

pronunciation.title: Tone in apologies
pronunciation.body: I'm SO sorry for the deLAY. Voice thodi neeche, slow. Fast apology rude lagti hai.

pronunciation.title: Pausing
pronunciation.body: Sorry — there was an issue — we're fixing it. Pause se message clear aur calm lagta hai.
